content: बहुधा {%ind.%} .²1 In many ways, variously, diversely, multifariously; बहुधाप्यागमैर्भिन्नाः <ls>R. 10. 26</ls>; ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक् <ls>Bg. 13. 4</ls>. .²2 In different forms or ways. .²3 Frequently, repeatedly. .²4 In various places or directions.
